description.value: Pemberton Station Neighbourhood Pub is a full-service neighbourhood pub in North Vancouver with a beer and wine store on-site and a loyalty rewards program. The venue caters to sports fans with dedicated sport pools and a TV guide section. Online ordering is available, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the area.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (1 space) at 59m. Total: 1 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at pembypub.com is live and accessible (prefetch_status: ok, looks_closed: false), confirming the business is operational. The website navigation includes an 'Online Order' link, which is positive evidence for takeout availability. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere in the scraped content, which is extremely sparse and consists almost entirely of navigation elements with no substantive body text. A name discrepancy exists: OSM tags the business as 'Pemberton Station Neighbourhood Pub' while the website consistently uses 'Pemberton Station Pub'.
